nodes.text:
1/ 📈 WWSCAN Weekly Data

Respiratory weekly update: Influenza A, Influenza B, & RSV are in ‘High’ category nationwide. SARS-CoV-2 is in ‘Medium’ category. The other respiratory viruses (HMPV & EV-D68) remain in ‘Low’ wastewater category nationwide and not in seasonal onset. https://t.co/6htleJXIh5

nodes.author: AltenbergLee
nodes.text: @WastewaterSCAN Your data is INVALUABLE. Thank you!

nodes.author: JPWeiland
nodes.text: @WastewaterSCAN I love the raw data you provide.  These analysis posts need a bit of improvement though.  RSV and Flu A are both clearly medium or low (not high) and both are decreasing steadily (not stable).  Posts say both are high and not decreasing. https://t.co/dOiXjw7Ivk

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 2/ COVID-19: Nationwide, SARS-CoV-2 is in the ‘Medium’ category with medium concentrations and a no significant trend over the last 3 weeks https://t.co/n3ED8639bs

nodes.author: mryoung151
nodes.text: @WastewaterSCAN What about the uptick in the Northeast? @michael_hoerger

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 3/ COVID-19 Variants: In sequencing data from a subset of WWSCAN sites, we are seeing the KP.1 variant in light green (51.9%) and KP.3 in light blue (15.3%) make up approximately 67% of variants. Note sequencing data has a longer lag of 1-2 weeks after collection. https://t.co/ufBGsJfpqU

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 4/ Influenza: Nationally, Flu A is in the ‘High’ category with high concentrations and no trend over the last 3 weeks. Flu B is in seasonal onset and in the ‘High’ category nationally with high concentrations and no trend. https://t.co/nFM3OEWlSH

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 5/ H5 influenza marker: H5 has been detected in 26 states since monitoring began - 6 in the West, 7 in the Midwest, 7 in the South, & 6 in the Northeast. As of 4/9/25, 17 states reported infected cattle herds. Most recent wastewater detections have been in CA, MD, MI, MN, & NJ. https://t.co/FPuU8o3wbT

nodes.author: Dsquared306
nodes.text: @WastewaterSCAN Thanks. We know that Passaic Valley Sewerage Commission (esp Newark Bay) has been testing high for months, we’ll figure it out on our own

nodes.author: Dsquared306
nodes.text: @WastewaterSCAN Some of us are so curious why NJ has been so high for 4-6 months?

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 6/ RSV: RSV is in the ‘High’ category nationally with high concentrations with no trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/NcmULUOQ0l

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 7/ HMPV: HMPV is in the ‘Low’ category nationally, but is in onset and in the ‘High’ category in some regions (West and Northeast). https://t.co/8rpdnk9fHI

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 8/ Norovirus: Norovirus is in the ‘High’ category nationally with high concentrations and no significant trend over the last 3 weeks. All regions except the West remain in the ‘High’ category. https://t.co/sVepH2ErIz
